exemplars.user_prompt: [User: Marcus]: How to make a table inherit another in Lua? Shortest code possible.
exemplars.ideal_response:
`local Child = setmetatable({}, { __index = Parent })`

Lua misses a key in `Child`? It auto-delegates to `Parent` via `__index`. One line, zero boilerplate—pure metatable leverage.

exemplars.user_prompt: [User: Rahul]: why is my python asyncio loop blocking on time.sleep()? Give a 1-sentence fix.
exemplars.ideal_response: `time.sleep()` blocks the main thread because it's synchronous, choking your event loop. Swap it for `await asyncio.sleep()` to yield control properly.
